d: Short, jet black hair with straight bangs covering the forehead, paired with sharp, narrow amber eyes and a stern expression. The face appears as a young adult with a lean, athletic build. Wearing a black hooded jacket under a long, open crimson red coat, a black V-neck shirt, a dark grey utility belt, and charcoal grey tactical trousers with integrated grey and black knee guards. Accessories include a black baseball cap under the hood, black fingerless gloves, a large black tactical backpack, and a long-range sniper rifle.
